lede: After three years designing the Hollywood Comedy Shorts Film Festival, Opmet Osserpse led its rebrand into HollyShorts Comedy: a new name, closer to the parent festival, with the jokes left in.
lede_src: lede, with "Dalton Corr" credited to Opmet Osserpse as in the credits
work: New logo, festival poster, official website, AR activations, five badges

Poster_-fae31e.text: In 2025 it became HollyShorts Comedy, with a new identity aligned with the parent HollyShorts brand.

HSC9-Logo-a872ae.text: The laughter stayed; the old name went. The new mark sits beside the parent festival's.

w:badge-float.text: The badges kept the joke, turning each pass into an object, such as a director's chair for filmmakers.
